mapper.insert: INSERT INTO torn_stock_alpha_decision (decision_business_date, common_day_index, phase, decision_type, current_batch_id, selected_stocks_id, source_snapshot_digest, signal_reference_price, execution_bar_start_time, execution_status, failure_reason, rebalance_batch_id, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{decision.decisionBusinessDate}, #{decision.commonDayIndex}, #{decision.phase}, #{decision.decisionType}, #{decision.currentBatchId}, #{decision.selectedStocksId}, #{decision.sourceSnapshotDigest}, #{decision.signalReferencePrice}, #{decision.executionBarStartTime}, #{decision.executionStatus}, #{decision.failureReason}, #{decision.rebalanceBatchId}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (decision_business_date, phase) WHERE deleted = 0 DO UPDATE SET common_day_index = EXCLUDED.common_day_index, decision_type = EXCLUDED.decision_type, current_batch_id = EXCLUDED.current_batch_id, selected_stocks_id = EXCLUDED.selected_stocks_id, source_snapshot_digest = EXCLUDED.source_snapshot_digest, signal_reference_price = EXCLUDED.signal_reference_price, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE torn_stock_alpha_decision.execution_status = 'PENDING'
